text:
Predicates:
RankedHighly(x) ::: x is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
ActiveMajorPlayer(x) ::: x is one of the most active players in major tennis.
LostTo(x, y) ::: x lost to y.
Female(x) ::: x is a female tennis player.
Male(x) ::: x is a male tennis player.
AtRolandGarros(x, y) ::: x is at y.
Question(x) ::: x is a tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
Premises:
∀x (RankedHighly(x) → ActiveMajorPlayer(x)) ::: If someone is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association, then they are one of the most active players in major tennis.
∀x (LostTo(x, iga) ∧ AtRolandGarros(x, rolandGarros2022) → RankedHighly(x)) ::: Everyone who lost to Iga Świątek at Roland Garros 2022 is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
∀x (AtRolandGarros(x, rolandGarros2022) ∧ Female(x) → LostTo(x, iga)) ::: All female tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 lost to Iga Świątek.
∀x (AtRolandGarros(x, rolandGarros2022) → Female(x) ∨ Male(x)) ::: All tennis players at Roland Garros 2022 are either female or male.
∀x (AtRolandGarros(x, rolandGarros2022) ∧ Male(x) → LostTo(x, rafael)) ::: All male tennis players at Roland Garros in 2022 lost to Rafael Nadal.
(RankedHighly(coco) ∨ LostTo(coco, rafael)) → ¬Male(coco) ∧ AtRolandGarros(coco, rolandGarros2022) ::: If Coco Gauff is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association or lost to Rafael Nadal, then Coco Gauff is not a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
AtRolandGarros(coco, rolandGarros2022) ::: Coco Gauff is at Roland Garros 2022.
Conclusion:
ActiveMajorPlayer(coco) ::: Coco Gauff is among the most active major tennis players.
